method: Named boundary-centered erosion cut of the classical hexagonal-prism honeycomb. All owners are whole identity-oriented prisms. Dilate centers and container by 1+10^-6 and round to binary64 for strict clearance.

attribution.construction: Classical honeycomb and a named finite erosion cut; no novelty claim for the honeycomb.
